shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat surface
circular disc motifs with concentric inner ring and central boss
band of repeated small units along an edge
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow relief carving including circular/disc forms with concentric outlines and a central element, and each has a border-like row of small repeated units. Otherwise the content is quite different: A is a grid of stacked rectangular glyph blocks containing face-like and abstract signs arranged in ordered rows and columns, while B shows a single large spoked wheel with hub belonging to a vehicle, set against a scene with textured fabric or netting and a lower row of foliate units — a representational object versus a script-like array.
